name: smwmusic-the-ninja-warriors-final-stage
title: The Ninja Warriors - Final Stage
description:
This track has heavy bass and drum parts with a constant driving feel. The melody builds throughout, and has a long loop. The theme of this track is tense and foreboding and could work well for final/penultimate levels, ghost houses, or other similar situations.

Featured in the "Idle Hands" level in Grand Poo World 2
